implemented: Added data-only embed inline segments for Obsidian wiki embeds and Markdown image syntax, preserving target paths, fragments, labels and numeric width/height dimensions.
Added an inert renderer placeholder that exposes target metadata and accessible text without creating image elements, loading local or external assets, or navigating URLs.
Added focused parser coverage and kept escaped embed syntax as source text.
limitations: This slice deliberately does not load, decode or render attachment bytes; PDF/audio/video/transclusion behavior and external-open actions remain pending.
The placeholder proves safe visible representation only, not reference application rendering or cross-platform Electron interaction.
Reference application comparison, human validation, provider access, signing and publication remain outside this implementation evidence.
